_evidence: 0x00420e6b compares esi dword +0x32c+4k with dword +0x1c8 of record k of the four 0x300-byte records at 0x006380d8 (jle) and clamps it to that limit, else to 0 when negative (jge). +0x1c8 is per-record run-time state (a limit, image 0 so the jge was only taken for an exact 0); any i32 draws both clamps and the in-range case.
